name: @windower/sidecar-macos
description: Swift Package wrapper so turbo can drive swift build/swift test for the macOS sidecar.

scripts.codesign: if [ -z "$DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION" ]; then echo 'skip: DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION not set, skipping codesign/notarize (see CODESIGNING.md)'; else ./scripts/codesign-notarize.sh .build/release/windower-sidecar-macos; fi
